attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, lighting, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real grey/white side and brow hair, the prominent grey/white upper-lip moustache with curled outward ends, and the full long white beard. Keep the understated actual mouth opening partly concealed by the moustache, avoiding any exaggerated grin or visible teeth. Maintain the dark green military uniform with the neckline largely hidden behind the beard, showing only the small muted red collar/shoulder area exposed at the lower image-left and limited gold fittings visible in the primary view. Do not reveal hidden large chest medals or enlarge shoulder insignia. Ensure the rounded chin immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual uniform neckline mostly covered by the long beard, ensuring only source-exposed red and gold fittings remain, with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent any insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details indistinct and understated as observed.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Near-frontal/mildly angled bust in DARK GREEN peaked cap, broad GOLD decorative band/front motif and dark visor. Real grey/white side and brow HAIR, prominent GREY/WHITE upper-lip MOUSTACHE with curled/outward ends and FULL LONG WHITE beard. Keep the understated actual mouth opening partly concealed by moustache, no exaggerated grin/teeth. DARK GREEN military uniform with neckline largely hidden behind beard, small muted RED collar/shoulder area actually exposed at lower IMAGE-LEFT and only limited gold fittings visible in primary. Do not reveal hidden large chest medals or enlarge shoulder insignia. Source lighting/crop and compact round mascot head/short broad neck remain.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
